questions.stem: On a distance-time graph, what does a horizontal line represent?
questions.explanation: A horizontal line on a distance-time graph means the distance is not changing over time, which indicates the object is stationary (not moving).

questions.stem: What does the gradient (slope) of a distance-time graph represent?
questions.explanation: The gradient of a distance-time graph equals distance divided by time, which is speed. A steeper gradient means a faster speed.
